messages:
Maya S: Customer (Acme Co) reported repeated card declines during checkout. User sees a 3DS prompt, completes auth, then our API returns 402 "payment_required" and UI shows 'declined'. They tried again and now there's a pending authorization. Customer upset, wants refund or capture. Raising here for repro + next steps.

Ben (Support): Seen a couple similar ones today. Do we have request_id or charge id? Any gateway errors?

Maya S: Paste from customer: `charge_id=ch_acme_01F8...`, request_id=api_rq_01G9... They say web flow shows success on issuer, then our page says decline. Customer says bank debited once (pending) after 2nd try.

Lina (Payments Eng): Thanks — can you paste the raw response we logged for that request_id? I want to see acquirer code + 3DS result.

Maya S: Raw from logs (redacted):
```
POST /v1/charges ch_acme_01F8...
200 OK (3DS redirect) -> user completes; POST /v1/charges/confirm -> 402 {"code":"card_declined","decline_code":"insufficient_funds","details":{"sca":"success","acs_time":"2025-11-03T14:22:10Z"}}
Second attempt: POST /v1/charges -> 202 {"status":"pending_authorization","provider":"stripe-sim","auth_id":"auth_00A"}
```

Ben (Support): Hmm decline_code says insufficient_funds even though customer claims bank auth passed on first flow. Could be issuer authorizing then reversing. Also second attempt got pending. Might be our retry path mis-handling 402 -> retry which created second auth.

Chloe (Fraud Ops): I pulled ch_acme_01F8... — fraud scoring shows AVS mismatch + velocity flag. We placed a manual hold (policy=auto-fraud-hold) at 14:23 UTC which would explain the pending auth. The ACs showed SCA success but fraud policy can still block capture.

Raj - Billing: If there's a pending auth from second attempt we should either void it or instruct customer to wait for auth to drop. Do we have ability to release hold and capture the original? What's compliance here? Customer wants immediate refund for pending.

Lina (Payments Eng): For this merchant plan we can do one of: 1) void pending auth (recommended), 2) force-capture if merchant confirms goods delivered and dispute risk accepted. Need explicit approval from merchant (Acme) + legal signoff to force-capture.

Maya S: I asked Acme to confirm preferred action. They want refund/void the pending auth immediately.

Lina (Payments Eng): OK — I'll void the pending auth once fraud ops lifts the hold. Chloe, can you clear the fraud hold for this specific auth? I'm going to prepare the void command:
```
POST /v1/auths/auth_00A/void
Body: {"reason":"customer_request_support_refund"}
```

Chloe (Fraud Ops): I reviewed rules; I'll whitelist this auth (rule override) and clear hold for ch_acme_01F8... now. Marking as manual_override by fraud_ops:@chloe.

Chargebot: action=void_auth auth_id=auth_00A user=Lina result=ok timestamp=2025-11-03T14:30:12Z

Lina (Payments Eng): Void succeeded. Sent refund/void confirmation back to Acme. Also filed a follow-up RITM to check why our client retry flow triggered a second auth after 402. Tentative bug in retry middleware (it treats 4xx as idempotent on retry).

Ben (Support): Customer updated: 'Thanks, pending authorization removed, will monitor bank statement. Please confirm we won't be charged.' They asked if this will affect their account standing.

Raj - Billing: No charge occurred (voided). We should document in invoice notes and mark potential dispute window (7 days). I'll add an item to Acme's billing account: "Void processed 2025-11-03; potential issuer pending auth — no captured amount."

Lina (Payments Eng): Follow-ups: 1) PR to fix retry middleware to not retry on 402 with sca result present (tracked PAYMENT-4872). 2) Add logging hook to correlate auth_id <-> charge_id in retry path. 3) Run a quick sweep for similar patterns in last 24h.

Chloe (Fraud Ops): Will add an override checklist to reduce manual holds for low-risk SCA-success cases (FRD-212).

Maya S: Great. I've updated the customer and closed the immediate escalation. Will keep thread open until PAYMENT-4872 is resolved. Ticket: SUP-33219. :white_check_mark:

Ben (Support): Thx team :thumbsup: — closing on our side after PAYMENT-4872 is fixed and confirmation email to Acme.
